name: Kikai Fair
description: Kikai Fair is a calm, documentary landing theme designed for trade fairs, industrial machinery exhibitions, and technical community events. Inspired by modern exhibition hall aesthetics, it features faceted dark bands, high-contrast ochre accents, structured production timelines, and comprehensive multi-language support. Built with clear typography and strict full-width layouts, the theme presents running machinery, stand directories, and visitor registration with quiet precision.
